headline: A 2003 executive order created a White House Office of Global Communications.
what_it_does: This order set up a new Office of Global Communications. Based on the title, the office's job was to handle how the U.S. government communicates with people around the world. No summary was provided, so details about the office's exact duties, staff, and powers are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that share information with foreign audiences
who_it_affects.how: Their messaging to people in other countries may have been coordinated through the new office.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 21, 2003; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
